content: Supabase has no built-in OAuth email-domain allowlist. Two implementation options: (1) client/server-side check after OAuth callback -- read the session user's email, compare domain against an allowlist, sign out and reject if not matching (matches PROJECT.md's planned approach); (2) a Postgres trigger (BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE) on auth.users that validates the email domain against an allowlist table and raises an exception to block the row -- this variant is more robust because it blocks at the database level for every auth method (OAuth, magic link, password), not just the client flow, and survives even if a client-side check is skipped or bypassed.
